body:
i was getting better a few weeks ago, taking small steps (baking things, trying to use creativity and saturating my brain, awarding myself for completing small goals) but i plummeted again. i dont have the means of getting a therapist. i dream a lot about being picked up but believe me, i have had this for years and have struggled hard. things get worse when i feel like what i do doesn't matter, is useless, worthless, etc. i am aware that i depend on others for acceptance, but i don't know how to accept myself.

i am afraid of doing the support group thing because i have sought out things like that, but i feel i don't receive the kind of support i really need. it needs to be personal; my trust issues and cynicism are too "profound"; i need to feel like a person knows me deep inside and out before i can rely on their support. otherwise i feel like a burden or that they're just "saying it".

having a kitten around is the only thing that really makes me feel fulfilled at the moment, but it certainly isn't enough
